title: Canyon Ultimate CFR | Close up

takeaways.text: Adjustable one-piece cockpit in 39, 41 or 43 cm widths, a narrow zero-offset aero seatpost and a 3D-printed saddle on carbon rails.
This build pairs SRAM Red AXS 50/37 chainrings with a 10–33 cassette and power meter, Zipp 353 NSW wheels and 28 mm Schwalbe Pro One tires.
The size-M bike weighed 6.75 kg with bottle cages but without pedals.

disclosure: Filmed at Canyon's UK headquarters with a Canyon-provided bike; the build shown is SRAM Red AXS like the candidate, though wheels may differ by model year.
summary: A close-up and weigh-in of a size-M Canyon Ultimate CFR with SRAM Red AXS at Canyon UK.
